ca_bundle_help: path to rootCA.pem from mkcert, for example "$(mkcert -CAROOT)\rootCA.pem"
certificate_failed:
Certificate verification failed. requests does not read the Windows system store where mkcert -install puts its root. Add:
    --ca-bundle "$(mkcert -CAROOT)\rootCA.pem"
to the same command and run it again.
no_session: The server's response has no session: {text}
no_verify_ssl_help: turn certificate verification off completely (blunter than --ca-bundle)
